note: The harbour view shows the 1832 lighthouse at the right with a tapered shaft, gallery, railed platform, framed lantern, rounded cap and finial. It is evidence for the depicted circa 1838 form, not direct attestation of July 1835 details. Lantern-profile continuity into 1835 is an explicitly inferred model choice supported also by the documented bird-cage lantern. The lower shaft edge is partly lost in foliage and the image supplies no secure base diameter, surveyed position, paint colour, optic count or historical camera.
